title: Social chatter, a festival of her records and phone numbers
summary: Campbell and Hughes exchange pleasantries, planning a festival of her records.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing the interview: thanks, goodbyes and tape running out

blocks.x: I could sit here all night long. Yesterday I went to bed about 5 o'clock in the evening and I slept until about 11:00. I got up and ate and I went back to bed and I slept until about 6:00 in the morning, then I got up, and I get out of the house early.
You've had a lot of rest.

Oh, yes, I got out of the house early. But I call my wife every so often and let her know where I'm at, let her know I'm all right. Well, now, I'm going to have a glass of water and I'm going to get out of here.
Well, Mr. Hughes, it's been a pleasure talking to you.
It's been a pleasure talking to you. And you come any time.
Okay. I'm going to give you my telephone number.
S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943
we'll have a Maxine Sullivan Festival, we'll play the tapes of all her records. That's going to take three days.
